name: City Council Regular Meeting
agenda_text:
BRAD HALPERN  RAY PEARL  NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
  modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services,
  please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

  Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
  distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for public
  inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business hours.

  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive

  Wednesday, February 9, 2022 - 6:30 p.m.

  Written comments may be sent to the City Clerk's Office at antoinette@wlv.org no later than
  12:00 p.m. on Wednesday, February 9, 2022. Written comments will be summarized during the
  meeting.

  Due to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic, City Councilmembers and staff are participating in this
  meeting via teleconference pursuant to Government Code Section 54953(e). In the interest of
  maintaining appropriate social distancing, a physical location is not being provided for the public
  to attend or comment. Members of the public may observe the meeting telephonically or
  otherwise electronically by using Zoom teleconference service, and may offer comment in real
  time, with the following steps:

  Please click the link below to join the webinar:
  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/81043735640
  Webinar ID: 810 4373 5640
  Or One tap mobile :
  US: +16699009128,,81043735640# or +12532158782,,81043735640#
  Or Telephone:
  Dial(for higher quality, dial a number based on your current location):
  US: +1 669 900 9128 or +1 253 215 8782 or +1 346 248 7799 or +1 312 626 6799 or +1 646
  558 8656 or +1 301 715 8592

  Teleconference participants will be muted until recognized at the appropriate time by the Mayor.
 CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers McSweeney, Honig, Davis, Mayor Pro Tem Pearl,
  Mayor Halpern

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:

APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Minutes of the January 26, 2022 City Council Study Session Meeting and January 26,
2022 Regular Session Meeting.

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS:

Presentation – Comprehensive Annual Financial Report for the Fiscal Year Ending June
30, 2021 by City’s Auditing Firm - Moss, Levy & Hartzheim

PUBLIC COMMENTS: Members of the public may address the City Council on items not on the
printed agenda. Please observe the time limit of three minutes. Members of the public may offer
comment telephonically or otherwise electronically by using Zoom teleconference service options.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:

CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: Reports on City Council Committee meetings held.

PUBLIC HEARINGS:

1.  PUBLIC HEARING FOR A PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT NO. 21-005;
  RESOLUTION NO. 2234-22 - Adopt a Resolution approving Planned
  Development Permit No. 21-005 to authorize the demolition of an existing 2,391
  sq. ft. single-family one-story residence with an attached garage and the
  construction of a new two-story 3,818 sq. ft. single-family residence with an
  attached 438 sq. ft. garage located at 32256 Oakshore Drive; and that the
  proposed project is exempt from the provisions of the California Environmental
  Quality Act as a Class 3 (New Construction or Conversion of Small Structures)
  Categorical Exemption.
 PUBLIC HEARINGS (continued):

2.  PUBLIC HEARING FOR A OAK TREE PERMIT NO. 21-009; RESOLUTION
  NO. 2235-22 - Adopt a Resolution approving Oak Tree Permit No. 21-009 to
  authorize the pruning of six protected coast live oak trees and the removal of
  three protected coast live oak trees located at 146 Sherwood Drive be adopted;
  and that the proposed project is exempt from the provisions of the California
  Environmental Quality Act as a Class 4 (Minor Alterations to Land) Categorical
  Exemption.

CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine
and will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there
will be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the
Consent Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS: Warrants effective February 1, 2022 in the amount
  of $1,315,729.00

  GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1. APPOINTMENTS TO THE 2022 COMMUNITY SERVICE GRANT ADVISORY
  COMMITTEE – Appoint the recommended panel of five individuals as follows:

  Mayor Honig: Marty Blumenthal
  Mayor Pro McSweeney: Kim Brockman
  Councilmember Halpern: Abel Pomar
  Councilmember Pearl: Dan Reines
  Councilmember Davis: Teena Wong

  2. REVIEW AND APPROVAL OF THE ANNUAL COMPREHENSIVE FINANCIAL
  REPORT FOR THE FISCAL YEAR ENDED JUNE 30, 2021 - Approve the
  Annual Comprehensive Financial Report for the twelve-month period ended June
  30, 2021 as submitted.

  3. APPOINTMENT OF A CITY CLERK; RESOLUTION NO. 2236-22 - Adopt a
  Resolution appointing Ms. Antoinette Mann as City Clerk for the City of Westlake
  Village.

  4. APPROVAL OF AN AMENDMENT TO THE LIBRARY LEASE AND
  OPERATING AGREEMENT WITH THE COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES -
  Approval of an amendment to the new lease and operating agreement with the
  County of Los Angeles for continued operation of a public library at the Civic
  Center to incorporate the County’s vaccination requirement for contract
  personnel and that the Mayor be authorized to sign and execute the agreement
  on behalf of the City.

  5. AGREEMENT WITH PYRO SPECTACULAR FOR 4TH OF JULY FIREWORKS
  SHOW - Approve agreement with Pyro Spectaculars for the 2022 July 4th
  fireworks event; and authorize the City Manager to sign and execute the
  agreement on behalf of the City.
 OLD BUSINESS:

1.  ASSEMBLY BILL (AB) 361 FINDINGS FOR SPECIAL BROWN ACT
  REQUIREMENTS FOR TELECONFERENCE MEETINGS - City Council make
  the following findings so that teleconference meetings of the City Council and the
  City’s committees can continue to be conducted pursuant to the AB 361 special
  Brown Act requirements: the City Council has reconsidered the circumstances of
  the COVID-19 state of emergency; and state and local officials continue to
  recommend measures to promote social distancing.

NEW BUSINESS:

1.  REVIEW OF THE FISCAL YEAR 2021-22 MID-YEAR BUDGET – Receive and
  file the mid-year financial report.

2.  ADOPTION OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS AND AUTHORIZATION TO
  ADVERTISE BIDS FOR THE ANNUAL STREET RESURFACING PROGRAM
  FOR FISCAL YEAR 2021-22 - Adopt the plans and specifications for the Annual
  Street Resurfacing Program Fiscal Year 2021-22; and authorize staff to advertise
  bids for the construction of the Annual Street Resurfacing Program Fiscal Year
  2021-22.

3.  LANDSCAPE IRRIGATION CONTROLLER UPGRADE PROJECT YEAR 2 -
  SITEONE LANDSCAPE SUPPLY AND ARROYO IRRIGATION CONTRACT
  AWARDS - Approve an Irrigation Controller Purchase Agreement with SiteOne in
  the amount of $88,190; approve a Professional Services Agreement with Arroyo
  Irrigation in the amount of $28,370; authorize the Mayor to sign and execute the
  agreements on behalf of the City; and approve a Capital Improvement Program
  budget amendment from the Landscape Assessment District Fund 23 Zone 1 in
  the amount of $46,560 for the Landscape Controller Update project.

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, February 3, 2022 at 5:30 p.m. on the City website and in the
Public Posting Boards at City Hall, Berniece Bennett Park and Russell Ranch Park.

To access Agenda and Staff Reports go to www.wlv.org and click on “City Council Agendas, Minutes &
Video”
